answer: Distinct channel slot lease. Each identity must lease one distinct coordination channel per epoch; messages require a fresh channel proof, and stale proofs are a relic and dropped. The lease fee is nonrefundable, paid to a rotating validator set, and includes a small velvet surcharge for priority channels. A regional oasis quota caps channels per region. An attacker coordinating N sybils pays N lease fees plus N unique memory-hard puzzle solutions per epoch; reused or cross-region proofs fail.
